name: AUTOPILOT.OI Invoice Chaser
description_html:
Get paid. No awkward texts.

Tell it about a job and get a clean invoice. Tell it who owes you and it keeps the list, then writes the right reminder for how late they are: friendly first, firm only when it has to be. You read it and send it yourself.

How it works: you add the guide to a free Claude Project, paste one message, answer 7 easy questions, then type one word whenever you need it. It drafts; you decide.

What you type: invoice · owed · chase · paid · week

What you get (13 page guide, PDF): a setup helper that asks 7 easy questions and sets it up with you in about 15 minutes, tap by tap on your phone, a reminder schedule, a worked example and a cheat sheet.

You need: the Claude app (the free plan works) and your payment details.

Drafts only: it never sends messages or takes payments. Not legal advice. 30 day refund: reply to your receipt.

AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic. Claude is a product of Anthropic.
